tagline: Programming with maximum meaning per token.
compilation_pipeline: static checking + storage effects + resolved calls
backend: LLVM IR; LLVM ORC LLJIT for the REPL, Clang++ AOT for direct execution/build/run
native_runtime_library: platform static archive: libquidra_runtime.a on Linux/macOS; quidra_runtime.lib on Windows
native_runtime_model: small C ABI support library linked into generated AOT executables plus a shared runtime loaded by ORC JIT for REPL submissions; direct file execution uses the same AOT linker/runtime path as persistent builds
binding_model: typed optional initializer with definite initialization; const T requires an initializer and removes write authority through that binding; fixed arrays allocate storage immediately with per-element initialization tracking; class fields may be partially initialized; bare auto requires an initializer and infers the non-error success side with fail-fast error handling; auto | error explicitly retains the inferred failure channel
call_style: positional arguments precede named name = value arguments; every parameter appears at most once; unknown, extra and missing arguments are rejected; typed defaults are supported; writable T & parameters use &value or &name = &value at the call, while const T parameters receive ordinary values without &
write_capability: &storage forms a safe observable storage address; T & grants writable access to that storage, while const T holds an independent immutable value; there is no const T & read-only reference type and no implicit mutable aliasing
error_model: union containing error; success-only contexts and bare auto fail fast on error; auto | error retains inferred failure for local handling; try propagates error; exhaustive typed match
union_class_payload_model: class values must be fully definitely initialized before conversion into a union; matching a class alternative restores that complete initialization fact
array_type_syntax: T[], T[n]; dimensions precede name, outer dimension first; array(n) creates runtime-sized uninitialized element storage with explicit type context; array(n, fill = element) is fully initialized and evaluates the fill expression once before copying it with value semantics
array_growth_model: append(value), concat(other) and sorted() return new T[] values and never resize the receiver storage in place; sorted() is available on numeric, bool and string arrays of fixed or runtime size and is stable and non-mutating
compound_assignment_model: +=, -=, *=, /=, %=; assignment target is evaluated exactly once
loop_control_model: break and continue target the nearest loop; writable for iteration commits the current element before either control transfer
string_escape_model: backslash is literal; named immutable string values represent control characters
class_model: class Name [instance](parameters) [| error] always has a parameter list, even if empty; ordinary header parameters become members, local parameters are initialization-only; header members initialize first, then body statements execute in order while method bodies execute only when called; block locals never become members; an optional instance name names the fixed whole instance; bare class declarations are uninitialized until a whole value is assigned; construct and this are ordinary names; private members are accessible only within their declaring class; field-wise initialization and independent value copying are enforced
reference_binding_model: T &alias = &storage is a writable live reference; a local T &alias may start unbound, then bind or rebind with &alias = &storage; local references may target bindings, fields or array elements, but stored reference fields require stable storage; references may not be elements of arbitrary union, array or function types; const T & is invalid and const T is an immutable value
const_model: const T declares an initialized immutable value snapshot; const T parameters take ordinary value arguments rather than & addresses, and the compiler internally borrows them without copying when that cannot change observable value semantics; a const value cannot be written through or used to create a writable reference; const T & does not exist
reference_aliasing_model: multiple writable T & parameters may alias the same storage, including f(&data, &data) when their signatures allow it; a const T parameter takes a separate immutable value, not a read-only alias to writable storage; flow-sensitive storage effects conservatively account for aliasing
address_model: &storage is a safe abstract storage address, not a numeric pointer; & means storage access rather than write permission by itself; == and != compare storage identity for address expressions; no * dereference operator, pointer arithmetic, address-to-int conversion, address ordering, or general object-identity operator
equality_model: == and != compare values for ordinary values; class comparison recursively compares definitely initialized fields; arrays and bin compare contents; address expressions additionally support == and != for storage identity, while general object identity is not exposed
module_model: standard namespaces are always visible and cannot be imported or aliased; unquoted non-standard names resolve to installed packages without local-file fallback; quoted relative paths resolve from importer; quoted @/ paths resolve from command working directory; imported source modules are declaration-only; cycles rejected
cli_model: one declarative cli binding per root source; argument() denotes a required positional value, argument(default = value) an optional trailing positional value, option(default = value) a named --field value, and flag() a boolean flag; scalar CLI values include string, int, real64, real and bool; exact int/real text parses directly without a fixed-width intermediary, and typed arguments are checked before execution
file_model: standard file module with whole-text read/write and whole-binary read_bin/write_bin plus exists/is_directory/remove/copy/move/mkdir and deterministic sorted list; file.open returns a read-only value-semantic Handle, while file.create/file.append return writable Handles with independent logical positions and read_line/write/write_line/flush/seek/close operations; copied handles preserve the originally opened resource identity rather than reopening by pathname; text reads require valid UTF-8 without NUL; binary I/O preserves arbitrary byte-aligned bin payloads exactly; operational or text-representation failures are returned through error unions
environment_model: environment.get(name) returns string | none; environment.has(name) returns bool; absence is normal none; invalid host text fails deterministically rather than entering string storage
test_model: test.check requires bool; test.equal reuses ordinary value equality; assertion failure exits with status 1
time_model: time.Instant is monotonic-clock state; time.Duration is an opaque duration value; time.now(sync = false) and time.since(start, sync = false) do not synchronize GPU work by default; sync = true is the explicit timing boundary, with time.now synchronizing before the start sample and time.since synchronizing before the end sample so measured asynchronous GPU work includes completion time; time.now/since/seconds/sleep preserve time units in the type instead of exposing unitless numeric timestamps
gpu_execution_model: GPU compute, CPU-to-GPU upload, same-device GPU copy, memset, accelerator calls, collectives, and tensor-returning checked validation are host-asynchronous by default; same-device dependencies are backend-ordered without per-operation host waits; GPU buffers leaving source scope are retired behind stream events and cannot be recycled until prior queued work completes; checked GPU validation remains device-resident and reports at the next synchronization boundary; scalar-returning GPU operations synchronize once at the required CPU observation boundary rather than once per validation; gpu.sync(index), GPU-to-CPU observation, time.now/time.since only when sync = true, and final resource lifetime are explicit synchronization boundaries; backends do not silently substitute a synchronous transfer or compute path when asynchronous support is unavailable
random_model: random.generator(seed) creates an explicit deterministic Generator value; Generator.int uses a half-open [start,end) range without modulo bias; Generator.real64 returns [0,1); Generator.bool returns a deterministic bit; ordinary Generator assignment copies RNG state independently
process_model: process.run(program,args) launches the executable directly without implicit shell parsing and returns process.Result with started/status/output/error; output/error are UTF-8 text without NUL and invalid captured text fails deterministically; launch failure is distinct from a started process returning nonzero; process.exit(status) terminates the current program with the supplied int status and is namespaced rather than consuming the bare name exit
map_model: map.Map<K,V> is a deterministic insertion-ordered independent value container; set replaces keys without reordering, remove preserves the order of survivors, reinserting appends, get returns V | none, and keys/values return arrays; keys are integer types (fixed-width, int or nat), bool or string; real keys are excluded due to symbolic equality
set_model: set.Set<T> is a deterministic insertion-ordered independent value container; add is idempotent, remove preserves survivor order, reinsertion appends, and values returns insertion order; elements are integer types (fixed-width, int or nat), bool or string; real values are excluded due to symbolic equality
json_model: json.parse returns immutable json.Value | error; JSON null remains a Value while missing object/array lookups return none; typed accessors return error on kind mismatch; duplicate keys are rejected; encode preserves object insertion order and number spelling; equal provides explicit structural equality
http_model: http.get(url) returns http.Response | error; response status/body(bin)/case-insensitive header lookup are explicit; HTTP 4xx/5xx remain Response while DNS/TLS/connection/timeout/protocol failures are error; only http/https are permitted and TLS verification remains enabled
generic_model: classes/functions/methods are monomorphized before checking; ordinary function/method overloading is forbidden, and repeated function/method names are legal only as one generic specialization family with identical argument count, parameter names, writable/reference and const forms, default-argument positions, and generic type-variable relationship pattern; concrete exact members may specialize that pattern, generic members may only narrow constraints, exact concrete matches precede generic matches, uniquely narrower constraints precede broader ones, and unordered overlapping domains are compile-time ambiguous; function and method type arguments are inferred when every generic parameter is uniquely determined by call arguments, otherwise explicit type arguments are required; a type parameter may carry one built-in compile-time constraint: numeric, integer, floating, ordered, or equatable; constraint failure is rejected before concrete body emission and introduces no runtime trait/vtable representation
numeric_model: int and nat are arbitrary-precision signed and nonnegative integers; int8..int64 and nat8..nat64 are fixed-width integers; real is exact and symbolic; real16, real16b, real32 and real64 are finite floating formats; com is exact complex and com16, com16b, com32 and com64 are floating complex formats. Half arithmetic computes in real32 and rounds once when storing each operation result.
numeric_implicit_conversion_model: already-typed numeric values never change representation implicitly; integer-family literals materialize only under a unique integer-family context and real-family literals only under a unique real-family context; auto and generic inference never choose a numeric concrete type from a bare literal
numeric_explicit_cast_model: T(value) is the explicit numeric cast form for scalar values and whole numeric arrays/tensors while preserving container structure and shape facts; floating-to-floating tensor casts preserve tracking and differentiate through the cast, while tracked casts to integer, bool or complex are rejected unless the graph is explicitly cut with untrack; range-checked conversions expose a whole-value converted-type | error and never wrap; integer-to-real and real-to-real conversions may round to the destination representation, while real-to-integer accepts mathematically integral values only and fractional rounding uses math.trunc/math.round/math.floor/math.ceil
numeric_text_model: numeric Type.parse(string) returns T | error; scalar value.string() returns the standard textual representation
bin_model: mutable packed raw bit sequence; bin.fill(n, bit) allocates bits, bin.parse(text) parses written bits, bin(value) is explicit representation conversion; indexing returns one-bit bin, slicing/iteration operate on bits, len counts bits, and equality compares values
value_copy_optimization_model: ordinary = has independent value semantics; unobservable storage sharing, copy-on-write, copy elision, moves and reference counting are permitted; tensor views/copies currently use COW; & introduces observable aliasing
string_storage_model: string is immutable valid UTF-8 text with no embedded NUL; external text ingress validates before constructing a string; storage may be shared when unobservable
string_operation_model: len/index/find/slice use Unicode code-point positions; text[index] returns a one-code-point string; contains/starts_with/ends_with/find/slice/trim/split/utf8/codepoints are supported; string.from_utf8(bin) explicitly validates byte-aligned UTF-8 without NUL and returns string | error; string[] join(separator) assembles text in one operation, and repeated text = text + piece is linear overall because a sole-owner append reuses storage unobservably
semantic_compression: surface syntax minimizes ceremony while preserving distinctions that change meaning
compiler_stage_model: parsed Program -> ResolvedProgram -> ConcreteProgram -> CheckedProgram -> typed IR
ir_reference_authority_model: typed IR preserves writable T & storage access and immutable const T value authority; an internally borrowed const value never grants a source-visible read-only reference or writable alias
call_resolution_model: checker resolves each direct call as function, builtin, exact numeric cast, or constructor before IR lowering
storage_effect_model: StorageEffect tracks read-before-write requirements, writes, guaranteed initialization and invalidation on method receivers and writable reference parameters; immutable const T arguments carry read requirements but grant no writable authority, and call summaries propagate effects conservatively
inspect_authority_model: typed source inspection preserves sparse const/reference authority for bindings, fields, and function parameters even when source text is omitted
none_model: none is a literal union alternative, not a synthetic function call
builtin_registry_model: builtin type names, aliases, callables, reserved-name checks, and describe output share one registry
value_storage_policy: Direct, ImmutableShared, or IndependentStorage; direct calls internally borrow provably read-only by-value aggregates, while independently mutable aggregates clone when independent ownership is required; future COW remains permitted when unobservable
memory_management_model: deterministic managed ownership; typed IR emits retain/release, safe references pin containing allocations, composite drops recursively release children, and stdlib calls borrow operands unless ownership transfer is explicit
managed_registry_model: per-execution-thread ownership registry without process-wide locking; owner/pin overflow and underflow are runtime-checked; current language semantics do not expose cross-thread managed-value sharing
call_depth_model: dynamic depth guards are emitted for functions participating in recursive call cycles; acyclic direct calls carry no depth-bookkeeping overhead
native_optimization_level: Clang -O3 without fast-math; checked arithmetic and language safety semantics remain explicit
debugger_integration: quidra build --debug emits an unoptimized frame-pointer-preserving native binary without dead stripping; quidra debug launches lldb/gdb or QUIDRA_DEBUGGER; DWARF preserves Quidra source files, functions, statement locations, scalar parameters, and scalar locals while release builds omit debug metadata
c_ffi_model: top-level C extern declarations accept ABI-stable scalar and void results, scalar/bool by-value arguments, and capture-free func callbacks restricted to supported 32/64-bit integer and real ABI signatures; const string and const bin are call-scoped read-only value borrows without & at the call, while bin & is a mutable byte borrow; const tensor<T> and tensor<T> & are opaque tensor borrows with read-only and writable authority respectively; string/bin borrows lower to nonnull nocapture data pointers plus nat64 byte lengths, with no implicit C-string, encoding or ownership conversion; foreign failures use explicit status, numeric boundaries are checked, and libraries link via explicit --link FILE options
package_management_model: deterministic package store management: remote installs select immutable semantic-version tags, validate manifests, optionally fetch explicitly declared HTTPS platform release assets, reject unsafe archive entries, then publish atomically; local installs require explicit force replacement; no install scripts execute
package_lock_model: optional project quidra.lock pins the exact resolved direct/transitive installed-package name graph by deterministic package-tree SHA-256; compiler and LSP reject missing, extra, malformed, duplicate, or hash-mismatched lock state when present; package lock --check is non-writing
lsp_model: stdio LSP with protocol-default UTF-16 positions and full-document sync; compiler semantic information backs diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, completion, signature help, references, rename, semantic tokens, and document formatting through an unsaved root-source overlay
formatter_model: lexer-span-based conservative canonical spacing; preserves literal/comment text and avoids guessing context-dependent angle/colon roles; fmt --check is non-writing
repl_model: accumulated accepted source; declaration-only submissions are validated without execution; executable submissions compile accumulated root source from an in-memory file-aware overlay and execute through LLVM ORC JIT without per-submission native linking, reconstructing runtime state with replay barriers for external/nondeterministic effects
repl_expression_display: typed IR display operation; void and never are not displayed; previously emitted stdout is baseline-filtered on later submissions
repl_state_persistence: bindings, declarations, functions, classes, generics, and file-aware imports are reconstructed from accepted source on each successful submission rather than stored in a persistent JIT heap
function_value_model: function declarations remain callable names and convert to capture-free first-class values only under an explicit func<R>(P...) context with an exact by-value signature; no closure environment, hidden allocation, bound receiver, implicit identity, or extern-function conversion is introduced
static_index_model: constant indices into arrays with statically known length are bounds-checked at compile time
array_initialization_optimization_model: typed IR preserves conservative complete-initialization proofs for local arrays so LLVM can elide only redundant element checks; writable reference escape or uncertain control flow drops the proof, whereas immutable const T values grant no write authority; bounds proofs remain independent
name_resolution_model: absolute reservation plus monotonic visibility: user code may never reuse a language-reserved identifier in any declaration position, including fields and methods; non-reserved names may not shadow currently visible declarations but may be reused in disjoint scopes where the earlier name is not visible; standard-library internal generated declarations are the implementation-owned exception
tensor_model: tensor<T> is a first-class dense numeric value with a mandatory static element dtype; tensor<T>{AXES} adds shape constraints using nat extents, _ unnamed axes, or nat shape variables; without ..., rank is exact, while one ... permits zero or more unconstrained axes with prefix/suffix constraints; captured shape contracts survive reassignment and flow-sensitive facts may refine; shape() returns nat[N] when rank is known and nat[] otherwise, while item() is the explicit scalar extraction boundary
tensor_initialization_model: tensor<T>(shape) creates per-element uninitialized storage; tensor.zeros<T>(shape) and tensor.ones<T>(shape) are fully initialized; tensor.zeros()/tensor.ones() may derive dtype and allocation shape from a fully specified expected exact shape but reject unconstrained rank or _ extents; shape knowledge never implies value initialization; uninitialized reads fail deterministically
tensor_value_model: tensor copies and slices preserve source-level independent value semantics; internal storage sharing is permitted and mutation detaches with copy-on-write; gradient destination state is also per tensor value and is never shared by ordinary assignment; slice assignment and writable tensor-element references are not exposed
autograd_model: floating tensors are untracked by default; track starts a graph, untrack disconnects, retrack cuts prior provenance; backward requires one or more explicit writable destinations and accumulates only into matching logical autograd identities; targetless backward is invalid; physical tensor/COW storage identity is not gradient identity; autograd.Target is the generic explicit destination handle used by higher-level abstractions without introducing Parameter/model/optimizer concepts into Core
tensor_device_model: CPU is the default tensor placement; gpu = n requests direct allocation on a non-negative Quidra GPU index; .gpu(n) and .cpu() are explicit copy boundaries; device is runtime/compiler metadata rather than nominal tensor type; implicit CPU/GPU or GPU/GPU transfer and CPU fallback are forbidden; operations preserve input placement and unsupported GPU operations fail explicitly

gpu_backend_model.index_space: one zero-based Quidra GPU index space per process

cuda.managed_component_lock: none; Core owns CUDA Driver API execution only and does not resolve package-owned vendor Math/NN libraries

hip.hiprtc: optional; absent hiprtc leaves transfers usable and compute unavailable

standard_namespace_model: standard namespaces themselves are reserved identifiers everywhere in user code; their qualified member names are resolved inside the namespace and do not automatically become global reserved identifiers; only referenced standard implementations are linked
package_model: unquoted non-standard imports resolve installed packages from configured package paths and never fall back to the current source directory
named_writable_argument_model: for read/write T & parameters, positional arguments use &value and named arguments use &name = &value
named_reference_argument_model: writable T & reference arguments use &value positionally or &name = &value when named; const T parameters take values without &
console_io_model: print and flush return void | error; print never appends a newline, flush explicitly flushes standard output, and there is no console write API or io namespace; scan reads one line against a format of {&target} placeholders and returns void | error; an expression statement whose value can be error fails fast
enum_model: nominal named enums with qualified payload/no-payload variants and exhaustive match; enum representation reuses checked tagged-union storage without dynamic dispatch or implicit conversion to structural unions
concurrency_model: parallel statements join every node at a barrier; checked storage effects determine dependencies and reject conflicting unordered writes or resources; then supplies an explicit dependency; managed captures retain value semantics and every started node is joined
class_reuse_model: explicit composition; a class contains only the fields and methods it declares; unions represent alternatives
math_package_model: generic mathematical semantics, reductions, linear algebra, FFT/decompositions, mathematical autograd, and Math-specific native/GPU/compiler policy are owned by the explicit first-party math package; Core provides tensor/device/autograd/compiler-extension mechanisms and basic language operators but no Math namespace or numerical-library compatibility surface
